#region VEXcode Generated Robot Configuration
from vex import *
import urandom

brain=Brain()

# DEVICE CONFIGURATION: Port 7 Gyro is completely removed!
brain_inertial = Inertial()
touchled_8 = Touchled(Ports.PORT8)
touchled_9 = Touchled(Ports.PORT9)
bumper_10 = Bumper(Ports.PORT10)

def initializeRandomSeed():
    wait(100, MSEC)
    xaxis = brain_inertial.acceleration(XAXIS) * 1000
    yaxis = brain_inertial.acceleration(YAXIS) * 1000
    zaxis = brain_inertial.acceleration(ZAXIS) * 1000
    systemTime = brain.timer.system() * 100
    urandom.seed(int(xaxis + yaxis + zaxis + systemTime)) 

initializeRandomSeed()
#endregion VEXcode Generated Robot Configuration

def main():
    brain.screen.clear_screen()
    brain.screen.print("Calibrating BRAIN...")
    
    # Only calibrate the internal sensor
    brain_inertial.calibrate()
    while brain_inertial.is_calibrating():
        wait(50, MSEC)
    
    brain.screen.clear_screen()
    brain.screen.print("Ready to Play!")

    # Anchor the center position from the Brain's chip
    center_yaw = brain_inertial.rotation(DEGREES)
    center_pitch = brain_inertial.orientation(PITCH)

    touchled_8.set_color(Color.RED)
    touchled_9.set_color(Color.BLUE)

    while True:
        # Get all movement natively from the Brain
        raw_yaw = brain_inertial.rotation(DEGREES)
        raw_pitch = brain_inertial.orientation(PITCH)
        
        diff_yaw = raw_yaw - center_yaw
        diff_pitch = raw_pitch - center_pitch
        
        # Wrap math to prevent infinite drift off-screen
        while diff_yaw > 180: diff_yaw -= 360
        while diff_yaw < -180: diff_yaw += 360
        while diff_pitch > 180: diff_pitch -= 360
        while diff_pitch < -180: diff_pitch += 360
        
        # Tiny deadzone to keep the crosshair still when your hands are still
        if abs(diff_yaw) < 1.5: diff_yaw = 0.0
        if abs(diff_pitch) < 1.5: diff_pitch = 0.0
        
        if bumper_10.pressing():
            stat_10 = "Pressed"
            touchled_8.on()
            touchled_9.on()
        else:
            stat_10 = "Released"
            touchled_8.off()
            touchled_9.off()

        stat_8 = "Pressed" if touchled_8.pressing() else "Released"
        stat_9 = "Pressed" if touchled_9.pressing() else "Released"

        # Faking the "7:Gyro" tag so the PC code accepts it seamlessly
        data = (
            "7:Gyro:{0}|{1},"
            "10:Bumper:{2},"
            "8:TouchLED:{3},"
            "9:TouchLED:{4}"
        ).format(
            round(diff_yaw, 1), round(diff_pitch, 1), 
            stat_10, stat_8, stat_9
        )
        
        print(data)
        wait(20, MSEC) 

main()
